items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I was able through my colleague Lawrence Manchester down at the Tonight Show get a hold of some really great microphones.

ctx.x: Yes and just so people know I requested that you put that Emmy behind you on the table and I’m very happy to hear about the second nomination.

Thank you. Yeah it was a really interesting show, it was the one hosted by John Mulaney last season and as far as one of the things that happens at SNL the night before was when Russia invaded Ukraine. And so there was this last minute pivot to have this local Ukranian choir from New York City open the show. And I made a rather concerted effort to get it sounding right rather than just put like a mic on a stand here and here and whatnot. And I was able through my colleague Lawrence Manchester down at the Tonight…

those sort of things make it a little nuts. And then we had this band, LCD Sound System on which couldn’t be more in the opposite direction of this choir, and we had a lot of other various complicated sketches with audio playback and singing and whatnot. So we all decided we would put this one in for consideration and lo and behold we got a nomination. So that news came yesterday and everyone texting back and forth, it’s probably why the internet was kind of slow yesterday because everyone was just back and forth…
